timeEntries.desc: Created list of supplies needed to service engines and ensure full set of spares onboard.
Removed forward tender latch on upper deck — mount interfering with latch.
Buffed gelcoat between cap rail and upper rub rail, port hull mid-salon to aft. Two to three passes fine compound. Applied coat of marine wax to entire hull.
Removed tape from vessel used for buff and wax.
Removed hardware to pull flybridge sliding hatch to replace broken rollers. Removed aft nav light for replacement.
Unloaded nearly 50ft of anchor chain, noticed paint markings needed touching up.
Installed new duckbills in overboard discharge pump and VacuFlush head using SuperLube. Labeled installation and disinfected work area.
Loaded tie-down lines in buckets with Oxiclean and hot water to soak. Started pressure washing — marine growth would not come off, returned lines to soak.
Loaded tie-down lines in buckets with bleach and hot water — OxiClean did not fully remove marine growth.
Picked up new LED nav lights and adhesive remover from LFS.
Installed two new navigation LEDs above flybridge. Voltage testing found aft nav light powered through anchor light breaker. Reassembled all wiring access panels.
Recorded tender filter part numbers for outboard service.
Set up workstation, removed forward/aft/top genset enclosure panels with peeling insulation. Scraped old insulation, stripped remaining adhesive with 3M Adhesive Remover.
Removed corrosion from all underwater zinc contact points using wire wheel, masked zincs for bottom paint, installed ensuring proper metal-to-metal contact.
Created haul estimate per Abe's request.
Cleaned panels with acetone. Cut and installed new insulation on aft panel, secured fraying seams with butyl tape.
Removed engine oil and filters all engines, transmission oil and raw water zincs from main engines, installed new raw water impellers using SuperLube, removed and cleaned air filters.
Picked up new engine zincs and painting supplies from LFS.
Masked off bottom paint on vessel to prep for new coat.

Installed new oil/fuel/crankcase vent filters all engines. New impeller in generator. Pumped new oil, topped off transmission. Tapped damaged zinc threads, installed new zincs. Labeled dates, cleaned with Simple Green.
Inspected circuit breaker lights — refrigeration and electronics dim, genset not functioning. Discussed priorities with Abe.
Inspected all stainless steel on vessel — cavil cleats and hawseholes needed attention.
Checked oil levels all engines, inspected belts, performed final engine service inspection.
Removed end cap from flybridge sliding doors, removed both doors to replace rollers.
Laid out additional 50ft of anchor chain, filled barrel with warm water, scrubbed painted chain markings, set out to dry.
Traced old insulation from top panel — five access ports. Cut and installed insulation on top and forward panels, reinstalled all panels, secured raw water hoses through top panel.
Disposed old engine oil at Squalicum Harbor, picked up painting supplies at LFS.
Applied oil to main engine air filters, installed filters, labeled inspection dates on all belts and air filters.
Hung painted chain markings on first 100ft. Mixed InterProtect 2000E epoxy with red coloring agent, applied coat to red markings.
Cleaned all bottom paint below waterline with acetone, applied new coat to approximately three-quarters of hull.
Discussed priorities with Abe, created new work list.
Laid doors on blanket, labeled teak strip locations, removed teak strips for Brightside Restoration. Removed nearly 50 fasteners.
Relocated vessel stands, applied bottom paint beneath them, transom, thru-hulls, thruster tunnel, rudders, and remaining quarter of hull. Removed all tape.
Dry-fitted new bow cradle mount bolts — too short, requiring replacement.
Replaced all engine oil absorbent pads, cleaned genset drain pan.
Loosened main engine fuel filters to bleed air accumulated during servicing — hand pumps not functioning.
Installed new freshwater filter, labeled installation.
Mixed yellow and red epoxy batches. Applied yellow to painted sections. Applied pink epoxy to insides of links on red-marked sections to seal chain.
Applied coat of red Omni paint to anchor chain markings.
Discussed priorities and port Tides Marine shaft seal with Abe.
Buffing estimate for high UV areas, inspected cockpit teak sealant, recorded photos.
Removed port Tides Marine shaft seal, inspected and cleaned shaft — noted early pitting. Repositioned housing 1/2 inch forward, installed new shaft seal, reassembled housing.
Buffed forward face of flybridge brow — three to four passes coarse compound.
Buffed and waxed forward flybridge brow — two passes fine compound, one coat marine wax.
Buffed top surface of hood forward of windshield — three passes coarse compound.
Fire extinguisher service by Pacific Rim Fire, assisted installing new mount.
Drained gear oil from windlass, removed and cleaned site glass, topped off with new oil. Consolidated used oil and old tender fuel for disposal.
Buffed and waxed hood forward of windshield. Two passes fine compound, one coat marine wax on top. Buffed starboard side two passes fine compound.
Installed UHMW slides, reinstalled teak strips and doors.
Repaired salon door — rubbing on buildup of varnish coats.
Additional door installation and adjustment.
Supervised sealant and stainless polish work.
Acquired P-clamps to secure Fireboy wiring. Installed missing port pilothouse teak trim fastener.
Removed master cabin bed, checked bow thruster oil levels, vacuumed thruster compartment, installed lug cover on thruster wiring.
Removed and primed fuel filters on all engines after servicing.
Repositioned and secured starboard engine room A/C light — stripped fastener, relocated 1/2 inch aft.
Treated new tender fuel with Sta-Bil fuel stabilizer, reinstalled tank.
Removed rust from port main engine hard piping, applied Corroseal.

Removed contents from lazarette, removed rudders, cleaned rudder shafts and shaft logs with degreaser, lubricated shafts with Triple Guard waterproof grease, reinstalled rudders, vacuumed and degreased rudder compartment.
Removed polishing tape, checked sealant prep.
Assisted installing flybridge sliding doors. Installed missing port salon teak deck trim fastener.
Coordinated vehicle access for vessel launch. Acquired tender fire extinguisher from Pacific Rim Fire.

Delivered shuttle car to Squalicum Harbor. Installed tie-downs, removed tools and supplies, secured tender with temporary cradle mount, assisted launching vessel. Tested all systems, delivered to Squalicum Harbor.
Buffed and waxed hood — two passes fine compound, one coat marine wax port/starboard/forward sides.
Unloaded 200ft of anchor chain, recorded markings after hearing they were painted incorrectly. Loaded chain back prior to launch.
Installed new sealant in seven locations on vessel. Cleaned all sections with acetone, removed tape, recorded photos.
Ran engines, checked fluid levels, topped off engine and transmission oil.
Applied InterProtect 2000E epoxy to port main engine hard piping cleared of corrosion.
Reinstalled Starlink and antennas post launch.
Picked up cleaning supplies at LFS. Cleaned lower deck and flybridge steps with TEKA cleaner — two-part solution.
Pressure washed nonskid decks, all canvas, and all marine growth. Sprayed flybridge deck with vinegar solution.
Picked up hardware for tender bow cradle mount at LFS.
Loaded all canvas aboard, recorded photos of recently installed sealant.
Washed the vessel.
Ran tender to flush fresh water through outboard, ran treated fuel through engine.
Cleaned salon windows, wiped countertops, vacuumed carpets to eliminate shop dust.
Removed genset sea strainer lid, cleaned corrosion at seal, applied Super Lube to seal to prevent leaking.
